## Subsection (b)(1) - General Definition

A "targeted low-income child" means a child who:

(A) Has been determined eligible by the State for child health assistance under the State plan;

(B) Is either a low-income child OR a child whose family income exceeds the medicaid applicable income level but does not exceed 50 percentage points above it (or meets alternative income criteria); and

(C) **"who is not found to be eligible for medical assistance under subchapter XIX or, subject to paragraph (5), covered under a group health plan or under health insurance coverage"**

The definition does not include:

(A) Children who are inmates of public institutions or patients in mental disease institutions (with exceptions in paragraph 7);

(B) **"except as provided in paragraph (6), a child who is a member of a family that is eligible for health benefits coverage under a State health benefits plan on the basis of a family member's employment with a public agency"**

The key exclusion involves existing group health plan or health insurance coverage, though paragraph (5) allows states to waive this for dental-only supplemental coverage under certain conditions.
